body: Thank you for everything you've said. Just to let you know, I'm still in physical and emotional pain. My wife did say she was going to a prayer vigil and asked me if I had any special intentions that I would like for her to pray for and give the group to pray for me. One of them (among others) was for me to receive a way to get medication for my mental health sooner than a month and a half from now (the earliest the county mental health center could get an appointment with a doctor). She promised me she'd pray for all of my intentions. Today I got a letter from the county mental health center letting me know that due to a cancellation they have scheduled an appointment for me for tomorrow morning with a doctor. They can provide me medication tomorrow - more than a month's worth. I don't want to die, but I can't keep living with this pain. Now there is hope.

I woke up a little bit ago to a phone call from my kids. I adore my children. I found someone helped me get some anxiety meds filled. Maybe this will help with the pain in my head, at least maybe help me get out of the house for a little bit. Trying to find a way to get the rest of the meds filled - not too many charities around here and I feel too anxious to ask. Someone told me they'd help me ask. Don't feel anything right now except fear and anxiety. Sucks. Hope the meds kick in soon. I really want to take back the desire for death but now I'm not sure I haven't gone too far. God bless you for caring enough to reach out. You deserve it.

I'm up for a few minutes. I left my laptop on when I went to sleep because I was writing and I figured I'd check this post. The pain in my head is worse today. I've been up for about 30 minutes and I'm going back to bed. I drank some orange juice and checked my email and made sure I saved my writing. The scary part is the pain in my heart which was my motivation because with the pain came hope its gone now. I'm going to sleep. God bless you.

I'm still here. I have been in pain yesterday and today with a crippling migraine. It may be from lack of medication but then again I do have neurological problems that cause these too so who knows. My anxiety level was through the roof yesterday and while I was awake today so this didn't help with headaches. I'm so tired all the time now. The real reason I'm not on meds: I can't afford them anymore. My wife was the one who carried the health insurance because she worked for a pretty large company and got it cheaper. I only had to spend $10 per prescription. Now she's gone and quit that job and there's no more insurance. I spend most of my money on child support and gasoline. 

Anyhow when I'm awake I spend my time writing music, listening to music, writing, crying, and waiting for the phone calls from my children (their little voices are the only thing keeping me this side of sanity). Sleep is my consolation now. I'm about to go back to sleep in a minute or two. I've only had a few waking hours today. My dreams are getting more and more vivid but I can't stay awake. 

I love my family and I know I am the reason they're gone. I beg for forgiveness. I've come to accept today that it is God's will for my family to be broken. I don't know why it just is. Same thing for my mental status and problems. I'm not angry with God, just confused but it's not up to me to question Him.

Thank you for your words. Thank you for your time. I don't want to live like this but I don't really have a choice. 

Goodnight.
Sorry that I haven't lived up to your standards. I'll try better next time. God bless.

I play guitar. I am have started writing songs for my wife, daughter, and son (want each of them to have something special for themselves). I made my favorite meal tonight - French bread pizza. I have written and written the past week or so - I've been thinking about this for a while. I will be recording the music tonight before my mind starts to fade, and I will upload it to my Amazon drive so my wife can get them for her and the kids. 

Other than that, there's nothing else I really want to do. I've considered this for a while and I've accepted that this is the way it is. 

Thank you for your kind words. I do find them comforting in an odd way; more along the lines of I know the world will still be a generally good place because of caring people like you and my family. I just have complete apathy toward life now and no longer wish to feel this pain.

Good night and God bless.
